To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the GIS planning process is a critical component in the success or failure of a GIS project; (2) GIS planning is a continuous process that should begin at project initiation and end only after project implementation; (3) GIS planning should include all aspects of the project, from the business problem to be solved to the technical solution; and (4) the GIS planning model is a flexible tool that can be adapted to fit a wide variety of GIS projects.
